messages:
Marta R: Short sync: need release notes + whats-new blurb for docs publish today. I added a bare changelog in PR but we need polished copy and updated SDK snippets.
Eli T: Which PR is canonical?
Marta R: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/982 - highlights: adaptive routing mention, streaming-embeddings deprecation, JS SDK snippet cleanup.
Samir P: Ill handle JS. Do we call out the fallback policy change under Notable changes or only in migration notes?
Marta R: Notable changes  two-line mention. Keep deep migration steps in the guide.
Eli T: Draft whats-new (editable):
- Adaptive routing improved to reduce tail latency and cost during bursts.
- Streaming embeddings deprecated  see migration steps.
- SDK snippets updated (JS/Python/Go): retry semantics and function-call examples.
Jules: Known issue one-liner: "Prefix cache TTL can cause minor quality regressions on very long sessions when KV cache spans rollouts."
Samir P: Pushed JS snippet in PR 985. Streaming->polling example included:
```js
// old streaming
const stream = client.embeddings.stream({input: '...'});
// new polling
const job = await client.embeddings.create({input: '...', mode: 'batch'});
const result = await client.embeddings.poll(job.id);
```
Marta R: Add compatibility note: "Batch mode preserves order but increases latency for single-request flows."
Eli T: Added whats-new blurb to PR description and docs/whats-new/v1.4.0.md. Can someone proof?
Jules: release-bot found a broken anchor in migration guide (xref #polling-behavior). Fixed in c7f2.
Jen P: Python snippet mirrored in PR 990, client.poll naming confirmed. Also added a Dedicated migration tip: "Dedicated customers: consider conservative fallback thresholds during rollouts."
Marta R: Remaining checklist: proof whats-new (Eli/Marta), confirm SDK snippets across langs (Samir/Jen/Go lead), add known-issues to changelog (Jules), tag internal digest for CS/SRE (Marta). I'll merge after CI and schedule docs publish for 17:30 PT. Thanks :rocket:
